From the beginning, the goal has been to create an experience that feels professional, helpful, and reassuring rather than confusing or transactional. | A Brand Built With Purpose | Collision Care Xpress was founded in 2008 by Robert Molina, a collision repair professional who built the business through hands-on craftsmanship, operational discipline, and a strong focus on customer service. It is built through many decisions that shape the customer experience every day. That includes clear communication during repairs, help navigating insurance claims, regular updates, rental coordination, and a service approach designed to reduce disruption for the customer. | The company’s customer-first philosophy also influences the way the business presents itself.
